> # Load Libraries
> suppressPackageStartupMessages({
+     library(tidyverse)
+     library(janitor)
+     library(data.table)
+     library(here)
+     library(arrow) # for saving Feather/Parquet
+     library(assertthat) # for quick checks
+ })
> # Standardise key columns and coerce to character
> 
> std_keys <- function(dt, keys = c("accident_no", "vehicle_id", "person_id")) {
+     for (k in keys) {
+         if (k %in% names(dt)) {
+             dt[[k]] <- as.character(trimws(dt[[k]]))
+         }
+     }
+     dt
+ }
> 
> # Rename alternative column names to expected schema
> 
> harmonise_names <- function(dt) {
+     nm <- names(dt)
+     
+     # Vehicle id variants
+     
+     if ("vehicle_no" %in% nm && !"vehicle_id" %in% nm) {
+         dt <- dt |> rename(vehicle_id = vehicle_no)
+     }
+     
+     # Accident number variants
+     
+     if ("accident_number" %in% nm && !"accident_no" %in% nm) {
+         dt <- dt |> rename(accident_no = accident_number)
+     }
+     
+     # Person id variants
+     
+     if ("participant_id" %in% nm && !"person_id" %in% nm) {
+         dt <- dt |> rename(person_id = participant_id)
+     }
+     
+     return(dt)
+ }
> 
> # Safe fread + clean names + harmonise + standardise keys
> 
> read_clean <- function(...) {
+     fread(...) |>
+         clean_names() |>
+         harmonise_names() |>
+         std_keys()
+ }
> 
> # Percent missing helper
> 
> pct_na <- function(v) {
+     if (is.numeric(v)) {
+         round(mean(is.na(v)) * 100, 2)
+     } else {
+         round(mean(is.na(v) | v == "") * 100, 2)
+     }
+ }
